Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

This policy applies to iEventSpark, developed and published by American Group LLC, on iOS and Android.

ApplicationiEventSpark
iOS bundle idcom.americangroupllc.eventspark
Android packagecom.americangroupllc.eventspark
DeveloperAmerican Group LLC
Contactcontact@americangroup.ai

Accounts

The app does not require registration and does not create user accounts or profiles.

Device permissions

The app asks for the following permissions only when you use the related feature, and each request explains its purpose with the text below. You can decline any of them and keep using the rest of the app.

  • NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription — The video-meeting component can list your calendar events so you can join a session from them. EventSpark does not store your calendar data.
  • NSCalendarsUsageDescription — The video-meeting component can list your calendar events so you can join a session from them. EventSpark does not store your calendar data.
  • Camera — EventSpark uses the camera so you can appear on video in a virtual or hybrid event session.
  • Face ID — The video-meeting component may use Face ID to unlock saved meeting settings on this device.
  • Local network — EventSpark uses the local network to connect you directly to others in a session, which keeps video quality higher.
  • Location (while using the app) — Required by the video-meeting component; EventSpark itself does not collect or store your location.
  • Microphone — EventSpark uses the microphone so you can speak in a virtual or hybrid event session.
  • Photo library — The video-meeting component can share a photo from your library during a session. EventSpark never reads your library on its own.

Android permissions declared: ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, CAMERA, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROJECTION, INTERNET, MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS, RECORD_AUDIO, WAKE_LOCK.

Advertising

The app does not show advertisements and does not include an advertising SDK.

Purchases

The app has no in-app purchases.

Analytics and crash reporting

This release sends no analytics and no crash reports to us. If a future version enables crash reporting, this page will be updated first.

Network

The app connects to the internet to provide its features. Connections use HTTPS.

Data retention and deletion

Data the app stores lives on your device and is removed when you uninstall the app.

Children

The app is not directed to children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them.

Your rights

You may ask us to access, correct or delete personal data we hold about you by emailing contact@americangroup.ai. We answer within 30 days.

Changes

We will post any change to this policy on this page with a new date.
